tasks.title: Centralize stage emit and workflow log helpers
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-engine/spec.md#Requirement: Stage execution infrastructure exposes shared stage side-effect helpers
tasks.description: Add shared safe `emit` and `log` capabilities on `StageContext` and switch existing runners to use them instead of private `emitSafe` or `writeLog` helpers. The delivered capability is that Plan, Build, Check, and Integrate all reuse one stage-scoped side-effect boundary while preserving current event names and workflow log payload semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: `StageContext` exposes shared safe emit and workflow log helpers that preserve current event names and payload shapes
Plan, Build, Check, and Integrate runners no longer maintain duplicated private emit/log helper implementations
Focused tests prove emit/log helper failures are swallowed without changing successful event or log writes
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the helper stage-agnostic and do not rename SSE events or alter workflow log meaning.

tasks.title: Add shared non-Build task handler runtime
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-engine/spec.md#Requirement: Non-Build tasks execute through a minimal shared handler contract
tasks.description: Introduce the minimal shared task runtime boundary used by non-Build execution: executable task shape, handler interface, handler registry, `AgentSessionTaskHandler`, and `ServiceCallTaskHandler`. The delivered capability is that a task definition plus `StageContext` can execute through one normalized handler contract and return `StageTaskResult`-style output without taking over runner stage control.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared task runtime types and registry support executing an executable task with `StageContext` and normalized task results
`AgentSessionTaskHandler` covers success, failure, and retry-after-missing-artifact style result normalization for agent-session tasks
`ServiceCallTaskHandler` covers successful and failed service-backed task execution with normalized timing and status output
Focused tests prove handlers do not own checkpointing, stage transitions, or approval decisions
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Combine the type boundary with its first real handler implementations so the runtime is immediately usable.

tasks.title: Introduce static task loading for Plan Check and Integrate
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-engine/spec.md#Requirement: Static task loading is available for Plan Check and Integrate tasks
tasks.description: Add `StaticTaskLoader` and the minimal static task definition model needed to prepare executable Plan, Check, and Integrate tasks from `StageContext`. The delivered capability is that prompt or input assembly can be tested separately from execution, while ordering remains the order declared by static definitions and Build or Ralph logic stays untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: `StaticTaskLoader` converts static task definitions into executable tasks with resolved prompt or input fields from `StageContext`
Focused tests prove Plan, Check, and Integrate static definitions can each be expressed and loaded without runner-specific branching inside handlers
The loader does not add Build dynamic ordering, `dependsOn`, checkpoint, or Ralph execution behavior
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep this loader explicitly static so later Build or Ralph refactors are not pulled into this issue.

tasks.title: Route legacy repair and fix entrypoints through shared adapters
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-engine/spec.md#Requirement: Legacy repair and fix entrypoints remain compatible through shared adapters
tasks.description: Implement adapter-based dispatch that maps the current repair and fix task ids onto shared handlers while preserving existing compatibility exports and runner call sites. The delivered capability is that plan repair, build health fix, review repair, merge repair, and integrate health fix all execute through one shared mapping layer instead of runner-private hard-coded branches.
acceptanceCriteria: Current repair and fix task ids resolve through a shared adapter or registry path for plan, build, check, and integrate repair flows
Compatibility exports such as `runHealthFixTask`, `runReviewFixTask`, and `runPlanRepairTask` remain available or have equivalent preserved entrypoints
Focused tests cover review repair, merge repair, and stage health fix dispatch using the real task ids present in the codebase
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use the shared handler contract underneath the adapters, but keep legacy runner paths and exported wrapper names intact.

tasks.title: Delegate minimal Plan Check and Integrate task execution through shared runtime
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-engine/spec.md#Requirement: Agent-session tasks share a reusable execution primitive
tasks.description: Adopt the new static loader and shared handlers in the minimal Plan, Check, and Integrate execution paths that already fit the static model, while keeping current runner classes and workflow registration unchanged. The delivered capability is that these stages can prepare executable tasks via the loader and run them through `AgentSessionTaskHandler` or `ServiceCallTaskHandler` without moving stage progression, checkpointing, or approval logic out of the runners.
acceptanceCriteria: At least the targeted static Plan, Check, and Integrate task paths execute through `StaticTaskLoader` plus the shared handler registry instead of bespoke runner-local execution branches
Runners remain responsible for checkpoint writes, retries, reporting, checks, approval, and final stage success or failure decisions
`WorkflowEngine` default runner registration and the existing `BaseStageRunner` control flow remain unchanged
Build or Ralph execution is not migrated onto the new loader or handler model in this task
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Only move the static non-Build execution paths that match the new contract; leave full runner unification for follow-up issues.

tasks.title: Lock the shared task runtime in with focused regression coverage
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-engine/spec.md#Requirement: Service-backed workflow steps share a reusable execution primitive
tasks.description: Add or update focused workflow tests that prove the new shared boundaries preserve behavior for Plan, Check, Integrate, and repair or fix execution. The delivered capability is that future follow-up refactors can rely on direct contract coverage for shared emit or log helpers, static loading, non-Build handlers, and legacy repair compatibility paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Focused tests pass for shared emit or log helpers, `StaticTaskLoader`, `AgentSessionTaskHandler`, and `ServiceCallTaskHandler`
Focused tests pass for plan repair, review repair, merge repair, and stage health-fix paths using the shared adapter-backed execution path
Plan, Check, and Integrate regression tests confirm user-visible workflow behavior, event names, and workflow log semantics remain unchanged
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer focused deterministic tests at the new contract boundaries instead of broad end-to-end rewrites.
